∀ {e : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.Pending} {f : ℕ → ℕ} (n : ℕ) (σ τ : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State), Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.PendRel e f σ τ → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.Halts σ n → ∃ n' ≤ n, Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.Halts τ n' ∧ Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.Bounded σ τ n n' e.gap ∧ (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.PendRel e f (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.exec n σ) (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.exec n' τ) ∨ ∃ g, Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.AgreeRel g (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.exec n σ) (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.exec n' τ) ∧ Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.Covers g (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.exec n σ).heap (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.exec n' τ).heap ∧ (∀ a < e.base.size, g a = a) ∧ (∀ a < σ.heap.size, g a = f a) ∧ n' < n ∧ (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.exec n' τ).heap.size = (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.exec n σ).heap.size)
